result.title: Remember Less, Adapt Longer: Bounded-State In-Context Reinforcement Learning with Recurrent Summary Memory
result.summary: In-context reinforcement learning (ICRL) enables agents to adapt to new tasks without parameter updates, relying on memory to retain what they learn from experience. For agents operating continually, existing approaches using memory trade off bounded cost against access to past experience. Approaches using growing memories, such as full-history attention and accumulating summaries, incur storage and per-decision costs that increase with task length. Fixed-size memories bound storage but restrict access: sliding windows discard older steps, while recurrent networks compress even recent interactions into a hidden state. We introduce Recurrent Summary Memory (RSM), a Transformer policy that attends exactly to a short working buffer of recent interactions and carries a fixed-capacity summary of earlier experience. When the buffer fills, RSM rewrites the summary from its previous contents and the buffer, then clears the buffer, so deployment memory and per-decision cost stay $O(1)$ in task length. On long-running partially observable tasks, frozen RSM policies sustain their adapted performance for eight times the training horizon with about 1% of full-history memory, ending ahead of every evaluated baseline while growing memories deteriorate. When the task configuration changes mid-run, RSM re-adapts better than growing and recurrent memories. Clearing the summary or blocking the policy's access to it removes its benefit, while swapping in another task's summary steers behaviour towards that task. Together, these results show that our fixed-capacity summary can sustain in-context adaptation far beyond the training horizon.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 Recurrent Summary Memory（RSM）：一种 in-context 强化学习策略，只精确关注近期交互的工作缓冲区，并携带固定容量摘要；缓冲填满时用旧摘要与缓冲重写摘要并清空缓冲，使内存与单步开销不随任务长度增长，从而在长时任务上维持适应性能。
AI.relevance_reason: 「固定容量摘要＋周期性重写、仅保留工作缓冲」的状态维护方式，可能与 LVR 中受限 latent 工作区的长度泛化、压缩与信息保留的权衡相关，可供核查能否迁移为推理期 latent 状态的维护与更新机制；但该工作在 RL 部分可观测任务上，未涉及视觉或多模态推理。
